entities.name: Authentication Procedure
entities.description: Network authentication procedure using EAP-AKA' method, involving key generation and security context establishment.

entities.name: EAP-response/AKA'-challenge message
entities.description: EAP response message sent by UE during authentication challenge phase.

entities.name: EAP-request/AKA'-notification message
entities.description: EAP notification message sent when AT_RESULT_IND attribute is present in both request and response.

entities.name: EAP-success message
entities.description: EAP success message indicating authentication completion.

entities.name: AT_RESULT_IND attribute
entities.description: EAP-AKA' attribute indicating result indication capability.

entities.name: EMSK
entities.description: Extended Master Session Key generated by AUSF when acting as EAP-AKA' server.

entities.name: KAUSF
entities.description: Key derived from EMSK or MSK for AUSF authentication.

entities.name: KSEAF
entities.description: SEAF key derived from KAUSF for access network security.

entities.name: MSK
entities.description: Master Session Key generated by AAA server when acting as EAP-AKA' server.

entities.name: KAMF
entities.description: AMF key derived from KSEAF, ABBA, and SUPI for NAS security.

entities.name: Partial native 5G NAS security context
entities.description: NAS security context created by AMF, identified by ngKSI and storing KAMF.

entities.name: AT_RESULT_IND attribute present condition
entities.description: Condition where AT_RESULT_IND attribute is included in both EAP-request/AKA'-challenge and EAP-response/AKA'-challenge messages.

entities.name: AT_RESULT_IND attribute absent condition
entities.description: Condition where AT_RESULT_IND attribute is not present in required messages.

relations.description: Authentication procedure includes reception of EAP-response/AKA'-challenge message.
EAP-response/AKA'-challenge message may contain AT_RESULT_IND attribute.
When AT_RESULT_IND is present in both messages, EAP-request/AKA'-notification is sent.
When AT_RESULT_IND conditions are not met, EAP-success message is sent.
Authentication procedure establishes EMSK when AUSF acts as EAP-AKA' server.
Authentication procedure establishes MSK when AAA server acts as EAP-AKA' server.
EMSK is used to derive KAUSF key.
MSK is used to derive KAUSF key when AAA server provides MSK to AUSF.
KAUSF is used to derive KSEAF key.
KSEAF is used by SEAF to derive KAMF key.
KAMF is stored in the partial native 5G NAS security context created by AMF.
